incident.en: Road traffic accident: single vehicle, motorcycle (bodaboda) or pedestrian
incident.sw: Ajali ya barabarani: gari moja, pikipiki (bodaboda) au mtembea kwa miguu

en: Switch on hazard lights and place warning triangles well before the scene.
Call 190 and inform the Traffic Police.
Stop bleeding by pressing firmly on the wound with a clean cloth.
Do not move seriously injured people unless there is a risk of fire.
sw: Washa taa za tahadhari na weka pembetatu za onyo umbali wa kutosha kabla ya eneo la ajali.
Piga 190 na wajulishe Polisi wa Usalama Barabarani.
Zuia damu kwa kubana jeraha kwa nguvu kwa kitambaa safi.
Usimsogeze majeruhi mahututi isipokuwa kuna hatari ya moto.

incident.en: Bus or lorry accident with many casualties
incident.sw: Ajali ya basi au lori yenye majeruhi wengi

en: Call 190 immediately.
Keep the road clear for ambulances and rescue vehicles.
Health teams: sort the injured by priority at the scene and activate hospital mass-casualty plans.
Fire and Rescue Force, Traffic Police and the Red Cross: coordinate rescue and account for all passengers.
sw: Piga 190 mara moja.
Acha wazi barabara kwa magari ya wagonjwa na ya uokoaji.
Timu za afya: pangeni majeruhi kwa kipaumbele eneo la tukio na amilisheni mipango ya hospitali ya kupokea majeruhi wengi.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji, Polisi wa Usalama Barabarani na Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu: ratibuni uokoaji na hakikisheni abiria wote wanajulikana walipo.

incident.en: Fuel tanker accident: overturn, leak, fire or explosion risk
incident.sw: Ajali ya gari la mafuta: kupinduka, kuvuja, hatari ya moto au mlipuko

en: Please do not collect or scoop leaking fuel; it can explode (Morogoro 2019: 105 deaths).
Move everyone at least 200 m away.
Call 114 and 190.
Police and Fire and Rescue Force: close the road and cordon off the area.
sw: Tafadhali usichote wala kukusanya mafuta yanayovuja; yanaweza kulipuka (Morogoro 2019: vifo 105).
Waondoe watu wote umbali wa angalau mita 200.
Piga 114 na 190.
Polisi na Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji: fungeni barabara na wekeni eneo la zuio.

incident.en: Boat or ferry accident on a lake, river or the sea
incident.sw: Ajali ya chombo au kivuko ziwani, mtoni au baharini

en: Throw something that floats (life jacket, jerrycan, log) to people in the water.
Do not swim out to rescue unless you are trained.
Call 190 and inform the Marine Police or Beach Management Unit.
Fire and Rescue Force and TASAC: coordinate search and account for all passengers.
sw: Mrushie aliye majini kitu kinachoelea (jaketi ya kujiokoa, dumu, gogo).
Usiogelee kwenda kuokoa isipokuwa umefunzwa.
Piga 190 na wajulishe Polisi Wanamaji au Kikundi cha Usimamizi wa Mwalo (BMU).
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji na TASAC: ratibuni utafutaji na hakikisheni abiria wote wanajulikana walipo.

incident.en: Aircraft accident: small aircraft, helicopter or passenger aircraft
incident.sw: Ajali ya ndege: ndege ndogo, helikopta au ndege ya abiria

en: Keep everyone at least 500 m away.
Do not approach until the fire risk has passed.
Call 190; the Tanzania Civil Aviation Authority (TCAA) must be informed.
Police: protect the site for accident investigators.
sw: Waweke watu wote umbali wa angalau mita 500.
Usikaribie hadi hatari ya moto iishe.
Piga 190; Mamlaka ya Usafiri wa Anga Tanzania (TCAA) ijulishwe.
Polisi: lindeni eneo kwa ajili ya wachunguzi wa ajali.

incident.en: Rail accident: derailment, collision or person hit by a train
incident.sw: Ajali ya treni: kuacha reli, kugongana au mtu kugongwa na treni

en: Keep away from the tracks; other trains may be coming.
Call 190 and inform the Tanzania Railways Corporation (TRC) so that other trains can be stopped.
Give first aid only where it is safe.
Do not remove wreckage until investigators arrive.
sw: Kaa mbali na reli; treni nyingine zinaweza kuwa zinakuja.
Piga 190 na ujulishe Shirika la Reli Tanzania (TRC) ili treni nyingine zisimamishwe.
Toa huduma ya kwanza pale tu ambapo ni salama.
Usiondoe mabaki hadi wachunguzi wafike.

incident.en: Building collapse: under construction or occupied
incident.sw: Kuanguka kwa jengo: linalojengwa au lenye watu

en: Do not enter the rubble; more of the building may collapse.
Call 114 and 190.
Keep everyone at least 50 m away.
Tell rescuers where trapped people were last seen; Fire and Rescue Force leads the rescue.
sw: Usiingie kwenye kifusi; sehemu nyingine ya jengo inaweza kuanguka.
Piga 114 na 190.
Waweke watu wote umbali wa angalau mita 50.
Waeleze waokoaji mahali walipoonekana mara ya mwisho waliokwama; Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji linaongoza uokoaji.

incident.en: House or market fire
incident.sw: Moto wa nyumba au soko

en: Leave the building immediately and help others out.
Stay low under smoke.
Close doors behind you, but do not lock them.
Call 114, and meet your family at the agreed assembly point.
sw: Toka kwenye jengo mara moja na wasaidie wengine kutoka.
Inama chini ya moshi.
Funga milango nyuma yako, lakini usiifunge kwa ufunguo.
Piga 114, na kutana na familia yako mahali pa kukutana palipokubaliwa.

incident.en: Factory or warehouse fire
incident.sw: Moto wa kiwanda au ghala

en: Sound the alarm and leave by emergency exits.
Call 114.
Tell firefighters about any chemicals stored on site.
Please do not return until the Fire and Rescue Force declares it safe.
sw: Piga kengele ya hatari na toka kupitia milango ya dharura.
Piga 114.
Wajulishe wazima moto kuhusu kemikali zilizohifadhiwa eneo hilo.
Tafadhali usirudi hadi Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji litangaze kuwa ni salama.

incident.en: School or hospital fire
incident.sw: Moto wa shule au hospitali

en: Sound the alarm.
Teachers and nurses: move pupils and patients out by marked routes; carry those who cannot walk.
Call 114.
Count everyone at the assembly point.
sw: Piga kengele ya hatari.
Walimu na wauguzi: watoeni wanafunzi na wagonjwa kupitia njia zilizowekewa alama; wabebeni wasioweza kutembea.
Piga 114.
Hesabuni kila mtu mahali pa kukusanyika.

incident.en: Petrol station fire or explosion
incident.sw: Moto au mlipuko wa kituo cha mafuta

en: Move at least 200 m away.
Do not use phones, cigarettes or open flames near the pumps.
Station staff: switch off power at the main switch only if safe.
Call 114; Police close the road.
sw: Ondoka umbali wa angalau mita 200.
Usitumie simu, sigara wala moto karibu na pampu.
Wafanyakazi wa kituo: zimeni umeme kwenye swichi kuu ikiwa tu ni salama.
Piga 114; Polisi wafunge barabara.

incident.en: Bridge or dam failure
incident.sw: Kuvunjika kwa daraja au bwawa

en: Communities downstream of a failed dam: move to higher ground immediately.
Do not cross damaged bridges.
Call 190 and inform Village/Mtaa leaders.
District Committees: warn downstream communities by radio and door-to-door, with the dam operator and TANROADS.
sw: Jamii zilizo chini ya bwawa lililovunjika: hamieni maeneo ya mwinuko mara moja.
Usivuke madaraja yaliyoharibika.
Piga 190 na wajulishe viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Kamati za Wilaya: watahadharisheni wakazi wa chini kupitia redio na nyumba kwa nyumba, kwa kushirikiana na mwendeshaji wa bwawa na TANROADS.

incident.en: Chemical spill: factory, transport accident or pesticide leak
incident.sw: Kumwagika kwa kemikali: kiwandani, ajali ya usafiri au kuvuja kwa viuatilifu

en: Move upwind and uphill, away from the spill.
Do not touch or smell the substance.
Call 190 and 114; report any label or number on the container.
Fire and Rescue Force, NEMC and GCLA: cordon off at least 100 m and manage the spill.
sw: Hamia upande upepo unakotoka na eneo la juu, mbali na kemikali.
Usiguse wala kunusa kemikali.
Piga 190 na 114; toa taarifa ya maandishi au namba iliyo kwenye chombo.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji, NEMC na GCLA: wekeni eneo la zuio la angalau mita 100 na dhibitini kemikali.

incident.en: Mining accident: pit collapse, rockfall, gas or flooding
incident.sw: Ajali ya mgodi: shimo kuporomoka, mawe kuanguka, gesi au mafuriko

en: Please do not send untrained people into the pit.
Call 190 and inform the Mining Commission.
Mine owners: count all miners at the surface.
Fire and Rescue Force: lead the rescue.
sw: Tafadhali msiwatume watu wasiofunzwa kuingia shimoni.
Piga 190 na ujulishe Tume ya Madini.
Wamiliki wa migodi: hesabuni wachimbaji wote walio juu ardhini.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji: ongozeni uokoaji.

incident.en: Electric shock or fallen power line
incident.sw: Kupigwa na shoti ya umeme au nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka

en: Do not touch the person or the wire.
Switch off power at the main switch if you can.
Call 190 and TANESCO.
If you must, separate the person from the wire with a dry wooden stick; give CPR if they are not breathing.
sw: Usimguse mtu wala waya.
Zima umeme kwenye swichi kuu ikiwezekana.
Piga 190 na TANESCO.
Ikilazimu, mtenganishe mtu na waya kwa fimbo kavu ya mbao; mpe huduma ya kuokoa pumzi (CPR) kama hapumui.

incident.en: Gas leak or cylinder explosion
incident.sw: Kuvuja kwa gesi au mlipuko wa mtungi

en: Open windows and doors.
Do not switch lights or appliances on or off.
Close the cylinder valve if it is safe, and leave the room.
Call 114.
sw: Fungua madirisha na milango.
Usiwashe wala kuzima taa au vifaa vya umeme.
Funga valvu ya mtungi ikiwa ni salama, na toka chumbani.
Piga 114.

incident.en: Radiological incident: lost or damaged radioactive source
incident.sw: Tukio la mionzi: chanzo cha mionzi kilichopotea au kuharibika

en: Do not touch or approach a suspected source; keep at least 100 m away.
Move upwind of the area.
Call 190 and inform the Tanzania Atomic Energy Commission (TAEC).
Do not eat, drink or smoke in the area; note who was near the source.
sw: Usiguse wala kukaribia chanzo kinachoshukiwa; kaa umbali wa angalau mita 100.
Hamia upande upepo unakotoka.
Piga 190 na ujulishe Tume ya Nguvu za Atomiki Tanzania (TAEC).
Usile, usinywe wala kuvuta sigara eneo hilo; andika majina ya waliokuwa karibu na chanzo.

name.sw: Matukio ya kijamii na watu wengi

incident.en: Crowd crush or stampede: religious gathering, sports event, market or school
incident.sw: Msongamano hatari wa watu: mkusanyiko wa kidini, michezo, sokoni au shuleni

en: Move with the crowd, not against it, and edge sideways towards open space.
Keep your arms in front of your chest to protect your breathing.
If you fall, curl up and protect your head.
Do not stop to pick up dropped items; call 190 once you are safe.
sw: Enda pamoja na umati, si kinyume nao, na sogea pembeni kuelekea eneo la wazi.
Weka mikono mbele ya kifua kulinda upumuaji.
Ukianguka, jikunje na linda kichwa chako.
Usisimame kuokota vitu vilivyodondoka; piga 190 ukishakuwa salama.

incident.en: Civil unrest or public disturbance
incident.sw: Vurugu za kiraia au fujo za umma

en: Please move away from the disturbance and keep children indoors.
Do not film at close range or take sides.
Call 190 and inform the Police Force.
Ward and religious leaders: help calm the situation and protect women, children and older persons.
sw: Tafadhali ondoka mbali na eneo la fujo na waweke watoto ndani.
Usichukue picha za video karibu wala kuegemea upande wowote.
Piga 190 na ujulishe Jeshi la Polisi.
Viongozi wa kata na wa dini: saidieni kutuliza hali na walindeni wanawake, watoto na wazee.

incident.en: Food poisoning affecting many people: wedding, school, market or restaurant
incident.sw: Sumu ya chakula inayoathiri watu wengi: harusi, shule, sokoni au mgahawani

en: Stop serving and eating the suspected food.
Keep a sample of the food in a clean covered container.
Take sick people and the food sample to the nearest health facility.
TBS, TMDA and GCLA: test the food and trace the source.
sw: Acha kuandaa na kula chakula kinachoshukiwa.
Hifadhi sampuli ya chakula kwenye chombo safi kilichofunikwa.
Wapeleke wagonjwa na sampuli ya chakula kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
TBS, TMDA na GCLA: pimeni chakula na fuatilieni chanzo.

incident.en: Contaminated or poisoned water source
incident.sw: Chanzo cha maji kilichochafuka au kutiwa sumu

en: Stop using the water source.
Village/Mtaa leaders: inform the community through religious leaders, meetings and radio.
Report to the water authority or RUWASA.
District Committees: arrange a safe alternative water supply; GCLA and NEMC test the source.
sw: Acha kutumia chanzo hicho cha maji.
Viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa: ijulisheni jamii kupitia viongozi wa dini, mikutano na redio.
Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka ya maji au RUWASA.
Kamati za Wilaya: pangeni maji salama mbadala; GCLA na NEMC wapime chanzo.

incident.en: Charcoal smoke (carbon monoxide) poisoning indoors
incident.sw: Sumu ya moshi wa mkaa (monoksidi ya kaboni) ndani ya nyumba

en: Open all doors and windows.
Carry the person out into fresh air and check other rooms.
Take the person to a health facility or call 190.
Never use charcoal stoves or generators in closed rooms.
sw: Fungua milango na madirisha yote.
Mtoe mtu nje kwenye hewa safi na kagua vyumba vingine.
Mpeleke kituo cha afya au piga 190.
Kamwe usitumie jiko la mkaa wala jenereta ndani ya chumba kilichofungwa.

incident.en: Snakebite
incident.sw: Kuumwa na nyoka

en: Keep the person calm and still.
Keep the bitten limb still with a splint; do not tie it tightly.
Remove rings, bracelets and tight clothing.
Take the person to a health facility as quickly as possible; do not cut, suck or burn the bite, and do not chase the snake.
sw: Mtulize mtu na asijisogeze.
Tuliza kiungo kilichoumwa kwa banzi; usikifunge kwa kubana.
Ondoa pete, bangili na mavazi yanayobana.
Mpeleke kituo cha afya haraka iwezekanavyo; usikate, usinyonye wala kuchoma jeraha, na usimfukuze nyoka.

incident.en: Crocodile or hippo attack
incident.sw: Shambulio la mamba au kiboko

en: Pull the person out using a rope or long stick; do not enter the water.
Stop bleeding with firm pressure on the wound.
Call 190 and inform TAWA.
Warn others to stay away from that part of the water.
sw: Mvute mtu nje kwa kamba au fimbo ndefu; usiingie majini.
Zuia damu kwa kubana jeraha kwa nguvu.
Piga 190 na ujulishe TAWA.
Watahadharishe wengine kukaa mbali na eneo hilo la maji.

incident.en: Elephant, lion or buffalo entering villages or attacking people or livestock
incident.sw: Tembo, simba au nyati kuingia vijijini au kushambulia watu au mifugo

en: Please do not chase or provoke the animal.
Report to TAWA, TANAPA or village game scouts.
Take the injured to a health facility.
Keep livestock in secure enclosures; report losses to Village leaders for consolation payment procedures.
sw: Tafadhali usimfukuze wala kumchokoza mnyama.
Toa taarifa kwa TAWA, TANAPA au askari wanyamapori wa kijiji.
Wapeleke majeruhi kituo cha afya.
Weka mifugo katika mazizi imara; toa taarifa ya hasara kwa viongozi wa Kijiji kwa taratibu za kifuta jasho au kifuta machozi.

incident.en: Bee or wasp swarm attack
incident.sw: Shambulio la kundi la nyuki au manyigu

en: Run straight away from the swarm and cover your face.
Go into a building or vehicle as soon as possible.
Do not jump into water.
Scrape out stings; take the person to a health facility if they have many stings or difficulty breathing.
sw: Kimbia moja kwa moja mbali na kundi na funika uso wako.
Ingia ndani ya jengo au gari haraka iwezekanavyo.
Usiruke majini.
Kwangua miiba; mpeleke mtu kituo cha afya kama ana miiba mingi au shida ya kupumua.

incident.en: Drowning
incident.sw: Kuzama majini

en: Reach with a stick or rope, or throw something that floats; do not enter the water unless trained.
Once out, check breathing and give CPR if the person is not breathing.
Call 190.
Take the person to a health facility even if they seem well.
sw: Mfikie kwa fimbo au kamba, au mrushie kitu kinachoelea; usiingie majini isipokuwa umefunzwa.
Akitoka, kagua upumuaji na mpe huduma ya kuokoa pumzi (CPR) kama hapumui.
Piga 190.
Mpeleke kituo cha afya hata kama anaonekana yuko salama.

incident.en: Lightning strike
incident.sw: Kupigwa na radi

en: People struck by lightning carry no electric charge and are safe to touch.
Check breathing and give CPR if the person is not breathing.
Call 190.
Take the person to a health facility and treat burns.
sw: Watu waliopigwa na radi hawana umeme mwilini na ni salama kuwagusa.
Kagua upumuaji na mpe huduma ya kuokoa pumzi (CPR) kama hapumui.
Piga 190.
Mpeleke kituo cha afya na tibu majeraha ya moto.

incident.en: Heatstroke or heat illness affecting many people
incident.sw: Kiharusi cha joto au ugonjwa wa joto unaoathiri watu wengi

en: Move the person into the shade and loosen clothing.
Cool the body with wet cloths and fanning.
Give sips of water only if the person is fully awake.
Call 190 or go to a health facility immediately; event organisers and school heads should provide shade and water.
sw: Mhamishie mtu kivulini na legeza mavazi.
Poza mwili kwa vitambaa vilivyolowa maji na kupepea.
Mpe maji kidogo kidogo ikiwa tu ana fahamu kamili.
Piga 190 au nenda kituo cha afya mara moja; waandaaji wa matukio na wakuu wa shule watoe kivuli na maji.

incident.en: Missing person, or person lost in mountains, forests or parks
incident.sw: Mtu aliyepotea, au aliyepotea milimani, misituni au hifadhini

en: Note when and where the person was last seen.
Call 190 and inform the Police Force.
Inform Village/Mtaa leaders; TANAPA or TAWA in protected areas.
Please share only verified information; do not spread rumours.
sw: Andika muda na mahali alipoonekana mara ya mwisho.
Piga 190 na ujulishe Jeshi la Polisi.
Wajulishe viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa; TANAPA au TAWA kwenye maeneo ya hifadhi.
Tafadhali shirikisheni taarifa zilizothibitishwa tu; msieneze uvumi.
